facts.text: Embry-Riddle's Daytona Beach campus features the O'Maley College of Business, the world's only residential college of business dedicated exclusively to aviation and aerospace.

sources.title: Aviation Careers Start with Embry-Riddle Business Degrees
sources.quote: The O'Maley College of Business (O'COB) on the Daytona Beach Campus is the world's only residential college of business dedicated exclusively to aviation and aerospace.
